fullPassage: Friedrich Mohs, a well-known mineralogist, was born on January 29, 1773, in Gernrode, Germany. He displayed a marked interest in science at an early age. In his late twenties, he went to Austria and classified minerals by their physical attributes. This new classification system of his led to conflicts with many mineralogists who followed the conventional methods. Mohs ended his remarkable career at the Mining University in Leoben and died at the age of 66 in Italy.
